subject: abbi-silverveil
q: Abbi has two different sets of three titles.
detail:
Her profile header reads The Foxhound Smith · The Anchor · The Hearth-Forger. Section 1 of the same document reads Twilight's Bottom · The Foxhound Smith · The Horny Smith. The Archive is displaying the header set — which now also predates her gremlinhood, so it may want rewriting rather than choosing.

ANSWERED 7 SEPTEMBER. The second set was intentional and they do not have to match. RETIRED.
